articles.summary: - Initial Ph2 data from SURF302 expected in September 2026 (n>40 enrolled to date) - - Initial Ph2 data from safety sentinel cohort (aggregate of ~25 children) in BEACH301, including new 5 th dose level, now expected end of Q1 2027 - - Appointed Jonathan Day as EVP, Clinical Development to advance
